logline: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.

promos.hook_text: THE FORMER GROOM: ""I cannot marry you, Juliana.""
promos.cliffhanger_text: LADY IN GOLD GOWN: ""And that quiet little face.""
promos.why_it_works: High emotional confrontation driven by groom (x6), marry (x1), tears (x2) with a tense unresolved cliffhanger.
